text_simplified: This text warns against injustice and differentiation among children, emphasizing the importance of justice and *rifq* (gentleness) in their *tarbiyah* (upbringing). It explains that the Prophet ﷺ urged equality in treatment among children. It also points out that injustice leads to estrangement and disobedience among siblings.

review_defects.why: العقوق is an Islamic term meaning undutifulness/ingratitude, especially toward parents; translating it as 'disobedience' loses the specific connotation and is not transliterated, unlike rifq and tarbiyah in the same text.
التفريق has a negative connotation of unfair distinction/discrimination; 'differentiation' is neutral and may not convey the warning against unjust favoritism.
